summary: Prepare keyed person-step and custom open-attention operators with complete public-row parity; production attention activation remains disabled

replay.detail: Normal Store open and production attention reads retain their existing computation. No production replay or backfill is introduced. Explicit unpublished operator installation uses bounded source and maintenance pages.

schema.detail: The opt-in operator schema adds local_attention_open, local_attention_open_dependencies and local_attention_open_dirty with indexes and source invalidation triggers. Only explicit Views schema installation creates these tables; normal Store schema/open hooks are unchanged. No numeric schema transition.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule, shared projection digest or fleet coordination change. These disposable operator tables are not activated in production by this change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire, schema-registry or harness contract changes. Existing public attention IDs, actions, recorded episode identity and current-clock/as-of wrappers remain intact. Partial families cannot replace the complete production collection.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or production startup work is introduced.

manual.detail: Existing installations require no manual action. Shared runtime integration and complete source certification are required before any future activation.

recovery.detail: Production remains on the existing full reader. Opt-in family output is disposable and never authoritative; unavailable or unflushed families reject reads rather than replaying from a GET or returning partial Ready output.
